details.intro: CAVT 114 is the History of Joseph in Cairo, Qaṣrīyat al-Rīḥān 115. That manuscript seems to have been destroyed in a fire (per Hany Takla). Frédéric Manns, who saw it, identified its text with the Arabic History of Joseph described by Graf, i.e. CAVT 113. Butts, Heal, Moseley and Witztum (2017) therefore recommend combining 114 with 113. The edition Manns announced never appeared.
details.manuscripts: • Cairo, Qaṣrīyat al-Rīḥān (Kasriat Errihan) 115, Hagr. 12, 75–80 (probably destroyed).
